title: Research agent
summary: Top-level README for a multi-agent research pipeline: overview, phase status, quick start, API surface, architecture, testing, deployment, and known limitations.
scope: public demo guardrails and rate limiting
notes: Genre is ambiguous between DOC and SPEC. SPEC signals present: an endpoint table under '## API', a supervisor routing table that reads as a behavioural contract, and an SSE event schema sample. Classified DOC because these describe an already-built system for readers rather than specifying contracts to be honoured; the document is prose-heavy overview with quick-start and license sections. No ADR signals (no frontmatter, no Status/Decision/Consequences) and no PRD signals (no user stories or acceptance criteria). Two sections are milestone-bearing for downstream synthesis: '## Status' carries nine roadmap checkboxes, all marked complete (phases 1-9), so no open roadmap items derive from it; '## Limitations' carries nine explicitly deliberate constraints (follow-ups cannot trigger new searches; critic shares the writer's model with the eval judge on a stronger model; offline evals cannot grade answer quality; cost uses list prices only; stores grow unbounded with no session ownership or expiry; SQLite pins to one machine; no connection pool; embedding-model change requires a new pgvector table; public demo is rate-limited but unauthenticated) which are the most likely source of next-milestone requirements despite this document not being a requirements artifact.
